# OpenTerm user reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_functions_doc.py from the function registry and keybindings. Edit the script, not this file. -->

OpenTerm is a keyboard-first market terminal: a command line on top, tiled panels below, amber on black.
Every action works from the keyboard; the mouse is optional. It runs with **zero API keys**; a key unlocks more
(a function that needs one says `KEY REQUIRED: set X in APIKEYS`). Data is never faked: a failed source shows
`STALE`, `ERR` or `PROVIDER DOWN` with its source and age, and test data is labelled on screen.

## Start it

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
.\scripts\setup.ps1     # once: installs backend (uv) and frontend (npm) dependencies, about 330 MB (-Dev adds the test tools)
.\scripts\start.ps1     # builds the frontend if needed, serves http://localhost:8000, opens the browser
.\scripts\install-launcher.ps1   # once: adds an `openterm` command, so typing `openterm` in any terminal starts the app
```

macOS/Linux: `./scripts/setup`, then `./scripts/start`. For development, `.\scripts\dev.ps1` runs the backend on
:8000 and Vite on http://localhost:5173. Demo without network: set `OPENTERM_FIXTURES=1` (recorded responses).

## The command line

Focus it with `/`, `` ` ``, `Ctrl+K`, or just start typing.

```
[N:] <SECURITY> [MARKET] <FUNCTION> [ARGS]     AAPL GP 1Y D · RELIANCE IN DES · 2: MSFT DES
[N:] <FUNCTION> [ARGS]                         HELP GP · N · FRED GDP
```

- `Enter` runs in the focused panel; `Shift+Enter` opens a new panel; `2:` targets panel 2.
- The security is sticky per panel: `GP` on a panel showing AAPL charts AAPL.
- `Tab` accepts a suggestion; `Up` / `Down` move through suggestions or history.
- Markets: `US`, `IN`/`NS` (.NS), `BO` (.BO), `LN`, `JP`, `HK`, `GR`, `CN`, `AU`. Explicit suffixes
  (`RELIANCE.NS`, `BTC-USD`, `^GSPC`) pass through.
- `HELP` lists every function; `HELP GP` explains one. `SHORTCUTS` (or `?`) shows the key bindings in force.

## Panels and the window menu

- Up to 9 panels. `Ctrl+\` splits vertically, `Ctrl+-` horizontally; `Alt+1..9` focuses a panel, `Tab` cycles,
  `Alt+W` closes, `Ctrl+Shift+F` maximizes, `Ctrl+Shift+Arrows` move the divider.
- Each panel keeps its own history: `Ctrl+[` / `Ctrl+]` go back and forward.
- **Window menu (`Alt+M`)**: every title bar has **RECENT**, **RELATED** and **OPTIONS** menus.
  - RECENT: the panel's history, newest first; pick one to jump to it.
  - RELATED: other functions for the panel's security (DES, GP, QR, FA, N, HDS, OWN, COMP, DVD, EE, ANR, OMON),
    or market functions (WEI, MOV, FX, CMDTY, CRYP, RATES, ECO, N) when there is no security.
  - OPTIONS: maximize/restore, split vertical, split horizontal, refresh, export CSV, close panel.
  - Keys: `Left` / `Right` switch menus, `Up` / `Down` + `Enter` or `1`-`9` pick, `Esc` closes. Clicking a label works too.
- Layouts: `LAYOUT SAVE MYDESK`, `LAYOUT MYDESK` (load), `LAYOUT` (list); `Ctrl+S` re-saves, `Ctrl+O` opens.

## Keys inside a panel

The focused panel gets plain keys first, so inside grids and charts commands start with `/` (or `Ctrl+K`).

| Key | In grids and lists |
|---|---|
| `J` / `K` or `Down` / `Up` | Move the cursor |
| `PageDown` / `PageUp` | Page (with vim mode on: `Ctrl+D` / `Ctrl+U`) |
| `Enter` | Open the selected row (usually its chart or detail) |
| `E` or `Alt+X` | Export the table to CSV |
| `F5` | Refresh the panel's data |

Charts (`GP`, `GIP`, ...): `1`-`8` pick the range.
Each function shows its own keys in the first (red) line of the panel.

## All functions

Type the code on the command line. "Security" = needs a ticker (or uses the panel's sticky one).
Arguments in `[brackets]` are optional; `A|B` means one of them.

### Charts and quotes

| Code | What it does | Security | Arguments | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GP` | Price chart | yes | `[1D..MAX] [D\|W\|MO\|5MIN\|1H] [VS SYM] [CANDLE\|OHLC\|LINE\|AREA] [LOG] [SMA20 SMA50 EMA20 BB RSI MACD VWAP ATR STOCH ADX OBV CCI WILLR MFI KELT DONCH SUPERTREND PSAR ICHIMOKU PAT:CANDLE PAT:SMC SMA100 SMA200 EMA50 EMA200]` | `AAPL GP` |
| `DES` | Security description | yes |  | `AAPL DES` |
| `Q` | Quote monitor (live) |  | `[SYM...]` | `Q` |
| `QR` | Quote recap (live) | yes |  | `AAPL QR` |
| `GIP` | Intraday tick chart (candles built from the live ticks seen since the session began) | yes | `[1S\|5S\|15S\|1M]` | `AAPL GIP` |
| `SEAS` | Seasonality (average return by month, weekday, day of month, ISO week) | yes | `[MONTH\|WEEKDAY\|DOM\|WOY]` | `AAPL SEAS` |

### Derivatives, rates and credit

| Code | What it does | Security | Arguments | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OMON` | Option chain: IV, Greeks computed here, open interest, volume | yes | `[YYYY-MM-DD] [ITM\|OTM\|ALL] [Q=pct]` | `AAPL OMON` |
| `PCR` | Put/call ratio by volume and open interest, per expiry | yes |  | `AAPL PCR` |
| `OV` | Option pricer: Black-Scholes, binomial, Heston, barrier, IV solver (NOT RUNNABLE until every input is given) | yes | `K= EXP=\|T= TYPE=C\|P [IV= R= Q=] [V0= KAPPA= THETA= SIGMAV= RHO=] [H= BARR=] [PRICE=]` | `AAPL OV` |
| `OSA` | Multi-leg option payoff, breakevens, scenario grid, Greeks by leg | yes | `LEGS=+1C270@5,-1C290 \| STRAT=BULLCALL,270,290 EXP=\|T= [IV= R= MULT= COMM=]` | `AAPL OSA` |
| `OVDV` | Implied-vol surface: expiry x moneyness heat map and fitted smiles (equity from the chain, crypto from Deribit) | yes |  | `AAPL OVDV` |
| `SKEW` | Skew by expiry: ATM IV, 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly, slope, term structure | yes |  | `AAPL SKEW` |
| `HIVG` | Realized vs implied vol, variance risk premium, rolling RV, local IV rank | yes |  | `AAPL HIVG` |
| `CT` | Futures term structure: contango/backwardation, spread to front, roll yield (month spacing) |  | `<ROOT: CL NG GC ES ZN ZQ ...>` | `CT` |
| `WIRP` | Implied fed funds path across FOMC meetings from ZQ futures (not a probability forecast) |  |  | `WIRP` |
| `COT` | CFTC Commitments of Traders: positions, weekly change, 3-year net history and percentile |  | `<MARKET: ES CL GC ZN EUR ... or name>` | `COT` |
| `FXFA` | FX forward estimate by covered interest parity (not a dealer quote) |  | `<PAIR> [1W,1M,3M,6M,1Y] [R1= R2=]` | `FXFA` |
| `YAS` | Bond yield analysis from terms: price/yield, accrued, duration, convexity, DV01, key-rate durations |  | `CPN= MAT= PX=\|YLD= [FREQ= SETTLE= DAYS= FACE=]` | `YAS` |
| `SWPM` | Vanilla swap valuation on the Treasury par curve (discount proxy, not SOFR) or a flat curve |  | `N= FIXED= TENOR= DIR=PAY\|REC [FREQ= CURVE=TSY\|FLAT:4.2]` | `SWPM` |

### AI (needs an OpenRouter key in APIKEYS)

| Code | What it does | Security | Arguments | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI` | AI research assistant over OpenTerm data: tool calls with sources, [T1] citations, UNGROUNDED / UNSOURCED flags (model output, not data; needs OPENROUTER key) |  | `[question... \| BT <strategy idea> \| AUTO <hypothesis> \| CHART \| DOC FILING <SYM> [FORM] \| DOC OFF]` | `AI` |

[--force] \| REPLAY <id> \| LIST]` | `SWARM` |

| `AUDIT` | Audit ledger of AI, SWARM, AI AUTO and BT runs: hash chain verified, manifests and tool calls (hashes only) |  |  | `AUDIT` |

## Global keyboard shortcuts

Rebind any of these in `SETTINGS KEYS`.

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `/` · ``` · `Ctrl+K` | Focus command line |
| `Escape` | Blur / close overlay / back |
| `Alt+1..9` · `Ctrl+1..9` | Focus panel N |
| `Tab` | Next panel |
| `Shift+Tab` | Previous panel |
| `Ctrl+\` | Split vertical |
| `Ctrl+-` | Split horizontal |
| `Ctrl+W` · `Alt+W` | Close panel |
| `Ctrl+Shift+ArrowLeft` | Move divider left |
| `Ctrl+Shift+ArrowRight` | Move divider right |
| `Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp` | Move divider up |
| `Ctrl+Shift+ArrowDown` | Move divider down |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | Maximize / restore panel |
| `Ctrl+[` · `Alt+Backspace` | Panel history back (Alt+Backspace: the back key) |
| `Ctrl+]` | Panel history forward |
| `F5` | Refresh panel data |
| `Ctrl+S` | Save layout (re-saves the current named layout) |
| `Ctrl+O` | Open a saved layout |
| `?` | Shortcut cheatsheet |
| `Ctrl+Shift+P` | Toggle PERF HUD |
| `Alt+X` | Export the focused panel's table to CSV (also E in tables) |
| `Alt+M` | Window menu: RECENT / RELATED / OPTIONS (arrows, 1-9, Enter) |
| `Alt+G` | Switch between TERMINAL and GUI mode |
| `Alt+H` | Help drawer for the focused panel (GUI mode) |
| `F2` | Sector key: EQUITY on the command line |
| `F3` | Sector key: INDEX on the command line |
| `F4` | Sector key: CURNCY on the command line |
| `F8` | Sector key: COMDTY on the command line |
| `F9` | Sector key: GOVT on the command line |
| `Shift+F9` | Sector key: CORP on the command line (no free data yet, shows why) |

## Data, keys and limits

- Keyless sources: Yahoo (quotes, charts, holders), Nasdaq, SEC EDGAR, FRED CSV, US Treasury, BLS/BEA calendars,
  RSS / GDELT news, CoinGecko and Binance, DefiLlama, Polymarket/Kalshi, World Bank/DBnomics.
- Optional keys live in `APIKEYS` (masked; stored in env, the OS keyring or `.env`, never in the repo or command
  history). `SEC_USER_AGENT` (your name and email) is needed for `FA`, `FIL`, `OWN`.
- `SOURCES` shows each provider's health and latency; `LOG` shows the backend log; `JOBS` shows background jobs.
- AI panels say `AI · <model> · <time>` and link the tool calls behind each answer; an answer with no tool data says
  `UNGROUNDED`. Backtests say `HISTORICAL SIMULATION, NOT A FORECAST`.
- What each source can and cannot do: [DATA_LIMITS.md](DATA_LIMITS.md). Example commands: [COMMANDS.md](COMMANDS.md).
